Liam (AE): Quick ask  BioEdge wants a 60-day on-prem POC, air-gapped. They want onboarding fee waived and Bronze included. Can we?
Cass (Sales Lead): any signal they'll convert? timeline?
Liam (AE): CTO said likely move to 12mo reserved if POC shows perf parity. No signed commitment yet.
Maya (Deal Desk): full waive is tough. Recommend conditional deferral: defer onboarding fee 90 days, 50% off platform license for POC months, include Bronze support and 10 SE hours. Require signed MOU + named POC owner.
Pri (SE): technical note: air-gap + BYOK needs 10-12 SE hrs + dry-run. We'll bundle 10hr, bill extra.
Rae (CS): I'll provide POC runbook and 4hrs training if we accept deferral.
PriceBot: list: ONPREM-ONBOARD $25k, PLATFORM $3k/mo, SUPPORT-BRONZE $2k/mo.
Owen (Finance): deferral OK with billing trigger in memo. If no conversion within 90d, invoice onboarding.
LegalBot: will need on-prem addendum; turnaround ~7bd.
Maya (Deal Desk): I'll draft memo: defer onboarding, 50% off first 2 months, Bronze included, 10 SE hrs, MOU+addendum required, conversion credit if sign 12mo within 60d post-POC.
Liam (AE): plz post memo link and I'll send the MOU/quest to customer.
Maya (Deal Desk): posting memo now -> https://redwood.company/dealdesk/memos/2101234567
